sow_rule: Seven Language Awareness lesson plans refer to SOW-based textbook review; two Project-Based Learning plans are CikguLaju proposals, not official SOW-prescribed projects. Teacher must choose SK/SP.

16.materials: English Plus 1 SB p.9 Activities 1,2,4,5; TB p.23; Starter Unit self-assessment; classroom objects
16.objective: Distinguish this/that/these/those in four near/far examples and identify one Starter Unit area to practise
16.criteria: Four contextual demonstrative responses, two checked answers and an individual review target

phases.label: Set Induction
phases.teacher: Run a brief Free Time language recall game.
phases.pupils: Recall familiar Starter Unit vocabulary and expressions

phases.label: Activity 1
phases.teacher: Guide SB p.9 Activities 1–2 and model demonstratives using four images.
phases.pupils: Choose this/that/these/those in four picture contexts

phases.label: Activity 2
phases.teacher: Position six classroom objects near and far and prompt full sentences.
phases.pupils: Describe six objects in pairs using suitable demonstratives

phases.label: Activity 3
phases.teacher: Guide SB Activities 4–5; check responses and reteach a specific misconception.
phases.pupils: Complete review tasks and correct inaccurate answers

pbd.teacher: Check two individual responses and note demonstrative errors.

closure.teacher: Collect Great/OK/A little self-assessment and identify follow-up.
closure.pupils: State a strength and one learning target

16.differentiation: Use real objects and visual cues; extend pupils with singular/plural near/far contrasts

34.materials: English Plus 1 SB p.20 Activities 3–4 and p.21 Activity 5; TB pp.34–35; Unit 1 self-assessment
34.objective: Review city language, exchange questions about Max's city, and complete the Unit 1 self-assessment
34.criteria: Completed city task, one correct pair question/answer and one review target

phases.label: Set Induction
phases.teacher: Recall Unit 1 town/city words and phrases.
phases.pupils: Name familiar places and phrases

phases.label: Activity 1
phases.teacher: Guide SB p.20 Activity 3 and comparison of phrases.
phases.pupils: Complete Activity 3 and check with a partner

phases.label: Activity 2
phases.teacher: Guide p.20 Activity 4 about Max's city.
phases.pupils: Write and answer city questions with a partner

phases.label: Activity 3
phases.teacher: Organise four-person bingo from p.21 Activity 5 and TB p.35.
phases.pupils: Play bingo and explain one correct response

pbd.teacher: Check responses and record one language gap.
pbd.pupils: Correct an answer and explain it

closure.pupils: Record a strength and next step

34.differentiation: Give place-word and question frames; extend confident pupils with reasons

52.materials: English Plus 1 SB p.30 Activities 3–6 and p.31 Activity 3; TB pp.44–45; Unit 2 self-assessment
52.objective: Complete Unit 2 review, use paired questions and identify a language target
52.criteria: Completed review exercises, a pair exchange, an error correction and self-assessment

phases.label: Set Induction
phases.teacher: Revisit Days vocabulary and Unit 2 structures.
phases.pupils: Answer short language recall prompts

phases.label: Activity 1
phases.teacher: Guide SB p.30 Activities 3–5; request an explanation.
phases.pupils: Complete tasks and explain one response

phases.label: Activity 2
phases.teacher: Organise SB p.30 Activity 6 in pairs.
phases.pupils: Ask and answer review questions

phases.label: Activity 3
phases.teacher: Guide SB p.31 Activity 3 and target errors.
phases.pupils: Complete the follow-up and correct answers

pbd.teacher: Sample written work and a pair response.
pbd.pupils: Show the work and correct an error

closure.pupils: Identify a strength and next step

52.differentiation: Provide sentence prompts and paired explanation; extend with an additional question

70.materials: English Plus 1 SB p.41 Activities 3–5; TB p.55; animal word cards; Unit 3 self-assessment
70.objective: Complete animal-language review, explain a clue and identify a learning gap
70.criteria: Completed Activities 3–5, one animal-clue explanation, one corrected response and self-assessment

phases.label: Set Induction
phases.teacher: Recall animal vocabulary and can/can't from Unit 3.
phases.pupils: Give useful animal-language examples

phases.label: Activity 1
phases.teacher: Introduce 'Stand in order' and guide SB Activity 3; organise Activity 4 in pairs.
phases.pupils: Complete ordering and paired review tasks

phases.label: Activity 2
phases.teacher: Guide 'What am I?' in Activity 5; invite advanced pupils to make three clue sets.
phases.pupils: Guess animals, explain choices and write clues if ready

pbd.teacher: Check Activities 3–5 individually and note common errors.

closure.pupils: State one strength and area for practice

70.differentiation: Model clues and give word banks; extend pupils with original clues

88.topic: My Dream School Day — CikguLaju Project Proposal
88.materials: Sample school timetable, A4 paper, drawing tools and subject word bank; no mandatory SB/WB/audio
88.objective: Create a timetable with at least four periods, explain two choices and present a group proposal
88.criteria: Four labelled periods, two clear reasons, participation and one answered question

phases.label: Set Induction
phases.teacher: Ask what makes school enjoyable and agree on criteria.
phases.pupils: Suggest subjects and activities from Unit 4

phases.label: Activity 1
phases.teacher: Organise groups of 3–4; check order, periods and shared roles.
phases.pupils: Plan 4–6 periods and assign tasks

phases.label: Activity 2
phases.teacher: Give a poster template and feedback on clarity and two reasons.
phases.pupils: Create a timetable poster with two explanation sentences

phases.label: Activity 3
phases.teacher: Organise presentations and one question per group.
phases.pupils: Present the school day, answer a question and justify a choice

pbd.teacher: Check timetable completeness, language, reasons and group contribution.

closure.teacher: Discuss one feasible idea from the presentations.

88.differentiation: Provide timetable and sentence frames; extend with extra justification

106.materials: English Plus 1 SB p.60 Activities 3,5,6 and p.61 Activity 6; TB pp.74–75; Unit 5 review sheet
106.objective: Complete Food and Health review, justify a response and identify a learning need
106.criteria: Reviewed tasks, one explanation, one corrected response and self-assessment

phases.label: Set Induction
phases.teacher: Display Unit 5 health vocabulary and ask quick questions.
phases.pupils: Use familiar words in short responses

phases.label: Activity 1
phases.teacher: Guide SB p.60 Activity 3 and model a reasoned answer.
phases.pupils: Complete Activity 3 and explain an answer

phases.label: Activity 2
phases.teacher: Guide p.60 Activities 5–6 and p.61 Activity 6.
phases.pupils: Complete tasks and compare selected responses

phases.label: Activity 3
phases.teacher: Guide Unit 5 self-assessment and reteach a recurring error.
phases.pupils: Identify strengths and correct an answer

pbd.teacher: Check individual review work and record follow-up needs.

closure.teacher: Invite one useful skill and an improvement target.
closure.pupils: Share one strength and next step

106.differentiation: Use vocabulary cues and partnered rehearsal; extend with independent explanations

124.materials: English Plus 1 SB p.70 Activities 2,3,6 and p.71 Activity 2 Sport Art; TB pp.84–85; Unit 6 self-assessment
124.objective: Complete Sport review, contribute to Sport Art and identify a language need
124.criteria: Individual review work, group artwork, a corrected response and self-assessment

phases.label: Set Induction
phases.teacher: Recall sport vocabulary and past-event language.
phases.pupils: Offer two familiar sport expressions

phases.label: Activity 1
phases.teacher: Guide SB p.70 Activities 2,3 and 6.
phases.pupils: Complete the review exercises

phases.label: Activity 2
phases.teacher: Organise dialogue practice with changing partners.
phases.pupils: Practise the dialogues and exchange responses

phases.label: Activity 3
phases.teacher: Guide SB p.71 Activity 2 Sport Art.
phases.pupils: Create the group Sport Art output

pbd.teacher: Check language responses, group effort and self-assessment.
pbd.pupils: Correct one answer and state a practice need

closure.teacher: Collect an exit response and recap Unit 6.
closure.pupils: Share one useful expression and a next step

124.differentiation: Give sport visuals and sentence frames; extend with richer descriptions

142.materials: English Plus 1 SB p.81 Activities 1,2,5; TB p.95; Unit 7 self-assessment
142.objective: Complete the three-boy table and Unit 7 review, then identify a learning target
142.criteria: A completed reading table, pair/individual answers, a correction and self-assessment

phases.label: Set Induction
phases.teacher: Review appearance and past-tense vocabulary.
phases.pupils: Recall descriptive words

phases.label: Activity 1
phases.teacher: Guide SB p.81 Activity 1 and model the three-boy table.
phases.pupils: Read and complete the comparison table

phases.label: Activity 2
phases.teacher: Organise SB Activity 2 in pairs and Activity 5 individually.
phases.pupils: Discuss pair answers and complete individual tasks

phases.label: Activity 3
phases.teacher: Guide Unit 7 self-assessment using actual review work.
phases.pupils: Identify a strength and difficulty

pbd.teacher: Review the table, individual responses and self-assessment.

closure.teacher: Collect an exit response on Unit 7 language.
closure.pupils: Share an expression and next step

142.differentiation: Provide picture cues and a sample table; extend with detailed descriptions

160.materials: Teacher-approved destination facts, brochure template and drawing tools; no mandatory SB/WB/audio
160.objective: Design a factual brochure with transport/packing facts and two eco-actions, then justify one choice
160.criteria: A labelled brochure, accurate facts, two eco-friendly actions, contribution and one answered question

phases.label: Set Induction
phases.teacher: Introduce responsible travel and agree on criteria.
phases.pupils: Suggest destinations and eco-friendly actions

phases.label: Activity 1
phases.teacher: Organise groups, roles and credible sources.
phases.pupils: Choose a destination, audience and two eco-actions

phases.label: Activity 2
phases.teacher: Review draft layout, facts and language.
phases.pupils: Produce labelled brochure sections and illustrations

phases.label: Activity 3
phases.teacher: Organise presentations and audience questions.
phases.pupils: Present the brochure and justify an eco-action

pbd.teacher: Assess facts, eco-actions, language, participation and response to a question.
pbd.pupils: Use feedback to improve one brochure element

closure.pupils: Share a useful idea and possible improvement

160.differentiation: Use picture prompts and sentence frames; extend with environmental-impact reasoning
